description: Generate a local browser-based report of Windows hardware, installed software, network inventory, and security status.

script: if ($detectedVersion -notmatch '^\d+(?:\.\d+){1,3}$') { throw "Could not parse Belarc Advisor version from installer: $detectedVersion" }

if ($entry.DisplayVersion -and $expectedVersion -and $installedVersion -ne $expectedVersion) { Write-Host "Belarc Advisor $installedVersion is a different version from this Scoop instance ($expectedVersion); skipping external uninstall."; return }

if ($command -match '^\s*"(?<exe>[^"]+)"\s*(?<args>.*)$') { $uninstallerPath = $Matches.exe; $uninstallerArgs = $Matches.args } elseif ($command -match '^\s*(?<exe>.+?\.exe)\s*(?<args>.*)$') { $uninstallerPath = $Matches.exe; $uninstallerArgs = $Matches.args } else { throw "Could not parse Belarc Advisor uninstall command: $command" }
if ($process.ExitCode -notin @(0, 1, 1641, 3010)) { throw "Belarc Advisor uninstaller exited with code $($process.ExitCode)." }

notes: Belarc Advisor is licensed for personal, non-commercial use only. Commercial, educational, military, and government use is not permitted under the standard license.
The installer uses the vendor-managed installation location rather than the Scoop app directory, so it may install outside your Scoop root.
The vendor's stable download URL is used. checkver reads the version from the installer's Windows file metadata, and autoupdate recalculates the hash from the downloaded installer.
